clue.text: Expert has to pass draft of treaty

parts.note: a pro is a professional, an expert
taken as written
a col is a mountain pass

explanation.surface: A specialist must approve the wording of an international agreement.
explanation.definitionFit: A protocol is the original draft or record of a diplomatic agreement, from which a treaty is prepared.

clue.text: Translation that may be extraordinary

clue.text: Giant fine picked up as asinine lover

clue.text: Planned quickly for emergency in cold spots

clue.text: Impudence, giving such insincere service

definitions.meaning: ... service is support given in words only, without sincerity

explanation.definitionFit: Cheeky talk is called lip, and hollow agreement is lip service.

clue.text: Like wordplay in speech? That may be fine

explanation.surface: Is a spoken play on words acceptable?

clue.text: Brontes' house servant admitting serious offence

clue.text: Note name, around time of hearing

parts.note: aural means relating to the ear or hearing

clue.text: Having taken coat off, start to sound warning

clue.text: Return smack in a little irritation

clue.text: Ambition to write arrangement for sitar and piano

clue.text: Manoeuvre by bishop following the action for a change

clue.text: One orderly more than others composed ditties

clue.text: Being of superior caste, I can't pair off
